em.pc_critic_response: The original assessment undercoded Problems as Low (stable chronic). The A&P documents chronic symptoms with lack of response to prior conservative therapy (PT) and prior injection “without benefit,” and proceeds with repeat injection to improve before invasive intervention—this is best classified as a chronic illness not at goal/poorly controlled (moderate). No separate A&P management exists for other conditions (e.g., hypertension/lisinopril) so they are not counted as problems addressed.
em.dc_critic_response: 1) DISC: I looked for explicit wording such as "discussed with" another clinician about management/test interpretation; the note only mentions prior evaluations by named providers and a referral back, which is not a same-encounter discussion, so DISC is not present. 2) Intpr: I checked radiology tests (MRI) mentioned; the note states MRI findings but does not document the provider independently interpreting the images (only referencing the report), so Intpr is not supported. 3) IHx: I checked for any history provided by someone other than the patient (e.g., spouse/parent report) or inability of patient to provide history; none is documented, so IHx is not present. 4) Tests & Documents counting: I excluded medication orders (lisinopril) and physical exam from data. I counted one unique test reviewed (left shoulder MRI report dated 12/12/2025, performed outside this visit but explicitly reviewed for current management) and one unique test ordered (CBC panel) for a total of 2 items; no other external notes/labs/imaging results are documented.
